label: copy phase: fed-back t/2/g as 2nd copied token (recall_idx 2), mostly L=9
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps), active only in the copy phase. It fires when the fed-back input is t or 2 (and sometimes g), which together hold about 97% of activation mass, almost always at recall_idx 2-3, i.e. when original token 1 or 2 has just been fed back (prev2_tok = <DEL> holds 79% of mass). It is strongly length-dependent: L=9 (t=11) holds 79% of mass and L=3 about 8%; it is nearly silent for L=4-7. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on first occurrences of a token. Even under these conditions it fires on only about 12% of matching steps. Preceding tokens w/v/a/k/q/d raise the rate somewhat but do not fully explain it, so the trigger seems to depend on hidden-state details that the predicate cannot capture. Magnitude is tiny (max 0.026). The top activations are L=9, recall_idx 2, input t/2.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=t (+5.68), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+4.69), t=5 & in_tok=t (+3.44), phase=2 & in_tok=g (+2.73), prev2_tok=<DEL> (+1.93), recall_idx=2 (+1.93). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.07), to_go=2 (-1.60), t=8 (-1.53), prev_tok=0 (-1.43).
